pages.en:
Perhaps the matter of Mitsuzuri still weighs upon me. Before I realize it, my feet have carried me to the archery hall.

There is no one here, so far from the school gates.

Practice is over. I cannot hope to learn anything by coming now.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Mitsuzuri’s case might still be affecting me, as I am at the archery range before I know it.
The range is far from the school building and seems deserted.
The club activities are over, so there’s nothing to find here.

その先、校門に続く路に、
立ち塞がるように、間桐慎二の姿があった。

pages.en:
“…………I should go home.”

I turn my back on the archery hall and begin walking toward the school gates.

There, blocking the path ahead—

stands Shinji Matou.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……I guess I’ll go home.”
I turn around and head to the gate.
And between me and the gate…
…Stands Matou Shinji, as if to block my way.

pages.en:
“I see. Too tired even to greet a friend?

“That’s what happens when you waste your time systematically erasing curse engravings.”

His voice curls into a sneer.

“——!”

I leap backward and assume a fighting stance before I can think.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I see. You’re so tired that you can’t even greet your friend, huh?
You’re tired because you’re doing meddlesome things like destroying the spells.”
His voice sounds delighted.
“!”
I jump back and ready myself.
